metadataRaw.title: How to Traction Your Middle Back at Home
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over how to traction your middle back at home. These decompression traction based exercises may give middle and upper back pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

These exercises are going to focus on pulling motions, or spinal decompression TRACTION, to help open up the middle and upper back.

A lot of middle back pain is caused from strain and sprain in the mid back that can build pressure into the thoracic spinal discs. If severe enough, you can get a bulging (or herniated) thoracic disc that may cause sharp, shooting middle back pain.  

The safe way to fix this is to reduce the pressure within the spinal discs... or simply decompress the disc. 

That way bulging material is brought back into the spinal disc, off any pinched nerves, which allows you to HEAL and have less pain.

These exercises are SAFE, effective, don't require any special equipment, and can be done in the comfort of your own home.

WATCH NOW and decompress your middle back and get feeling instant relief!
